name: @senzu/sdk-core
description: Senzu's contract math (the Rust core) as WebAssembly: health checks, lens searches, liquidation and market math, bit-exact with the contracts.

scripts.build: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build ../../rust-sdk/core --target web --release --out-dir ../../ts-sdk/core/pkg --out-name senzu_sdk_core --no-pack -- --features wasm && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
